bagPolicy.summary: The Regency Ballroom gives no bag size limit, but backpacks are searched and must be checked at coat check for the whole show. Luggage is not allowed.
allowed: Empty Camelbacks and reusable water bottles
prohibited: Backpacks inside the show (must be checked)
bagPolicy.note: Coat check is upstairs off the rotunda and costs $5 per item. No re-entry.

parking.summary: The venue lists nearby public and private lots, including the public lot at 819 Ellis Street, plus limited street parking.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The FAQ notes that rides can be found on Van Ness Avenue but does not identify a venue-designated rideshare stop.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The ballroom serves alcoholic drinks, including featured $8 beer, wine and cocktail deals. Outside food and drinks are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible entry is at 1270 Sutter Street; seating is on the main ballroom floor toward house left, and accessible stalls are on the main level and in the Social Hall and Lodge.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: There is no re-entry after ticket scanning, except through the venue’s designated smoking area.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will Call opens when doors open. Bring photo ID, the card used for purchase and the AXS confirmation number; ordinary tickets are scanned from the AXS mobile app.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors normally open one hour before the show, though concert times vary. The box office opens at the same time as doors.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
